item.title: Late Samar Hazarika, Dhanada Pathak to Receive Silpi Awards for 2026
item.description: Renowned singers Late Samar Hazarika and Dhanada Pathak have been named as recipients of the Silpi Awards for 2026. item.title: Assam to be Part of World Economic Forum for 1st Time, CM to Represent State
item.description: Chief minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Friday said that Assam will, for the first time, take part in the World Economic Forum (WEF) and he will represent the state before entrepreneurs from across the world. item.title: Two Kerala Tourists Drown in Arunachal's Frozen Sela Lake; One Body Found
item.description: A sightseeing trip turned tragic at Sela Lake in Arunachal Pradesh’s Tawang district on Friday, when two tourists from Kerala drowned after slipping into the frozen lake. One body has been recovered, while the search continues for the other victim. The deceased has been identified as 26-year-old B Prakash, while Madhav M (24) remains missing.
